01.title: The Habakkuk 2:14 Movement
01.description: The P2P movement, its vision and biblical foundation, and the global discipleship mission — as the waters cover the sea.

02.title: The P2P Global Vision
02.description: Why P2P exists: everyone learning from someone and helping someone grow, from one generation to the next.

units.u001: Every life of faith begins with someone who cared enough to share.
units.u002: A mother who opened the Scriptures with her child.
units.u003: A friend who explained what grace really means.
units.u004: A teacher who stayed to answer one more question.
units.u005: Someone shared the truth with them.
units.u006: And now, they share it with someone else.
units.u007: This is how faith has always moved: from one person to another, from one generation to the next.
units.u008: Paul told Timothy to entrust what he had received to faithful people, who would be able to teach others as well.
units.u015: Until the knowledge of the glory of the Lord fills the earth, as the waters cover the sea.
units.u017: And everyone can help someone grow.
units.u018: This is the vision of P2P Global.

03.title: Welcome to P2P
03.description: A first look around P2P: Home, Learning, the Bible, Messages and more — and how it all fits together.

units.u001: Welcome to P2P Global, the Peer to Peer Global Discipleship Network.
units.u002: P2P is a place to learn God's Word, understand it, live it, and help someone else grow.
units.u003: Let's take a short tour, so you know where everything is.
units.u005: Each day you'll find a Daily Word: a verse, with a short instruction to help you put it into practice.
units.u006: You can open the full chapter, listen to it, and see your growth stage at a glance.
units.u007: The Learning tab is where you grow in understanding.
units.u008: Kingdom School walks you through the Core Foundations, one lesson at a time.
units.u009: Kingdom Stories opens up the history of the Bible.
units.u010: P2P Plans help you study a subject at your own pace, and Study Together lets you learn alongside others.
units.u011: In the Bible tab, you can read Scripture in many translations and languages.
units.u012: Listen with the audio player, highlight the verses that speak to you, compare translations side by side, and search the whole Bible.
units.u014: Chat with the people you're learning with, create private groups, and write longer letters with P2P Mail.
units.u015: Under More, you'll find Prayer, with guided prayer paths, praying the Word, and a prayer journal.
units.u016: You'll also find Discover, where you can connect with other believers, find your church, and explore missions.
units.u017: My Profile tells your story: your growth, your discipleship relationships, and your journey from Seed to Sprout, Young Tree, Fruitful Tree, and Forest Builder.
units.u018: Growth here reflects real steps you have taken.
units.u019: It is not a measure of your worth to God.
units.u022: And remember: everyone is learning from someone, and helping someone grow.

04.title: What Is a Peer Guide?
04.description: What a peer guide is, why peer guidance exists, and how a guide walks alongside someone who is growing.

units.u001: Think of someone you shared Jesus with: a friend, a neighbour, someone you met just once.
units.u002: Now they have begun to follow Him.
units.u003: They're reading the Bible, but they have questions, and they're not sure where to start.
units.u004: Growing in faith was never meant to be done alone.
units.u005: Scripture says that two are better than one.
units.u006: If one falls down, his companion can lift him up.
units.u008: Because faith grows best in relationship.
units.u009: Jesus did not only teach the crowds.
units.u010: He chose a small group to be with Him: He ate with them, answered their questions, and prayed with them.
units.u011: And the early believers grew the same way, encouraging one another day after day.
units.u012: In P2P, a Peer Guide is a fellow believer who is one step ahead of you on the discipleship journey.
units.u013: Not a pastor or a teacher, but simply someone who has walked this path before you, and is ready to walk alongside you now.
units.u014: Your Peer Guide goes through the lessons with you, answers your questions, reviews your reflections, and prays with you.
units.u015: Think of them as a spiritual friend with a little more experience.
units.u016: You can ask for a Peer Guide when you first join P2P.
units.u017: Write a short greeting, and you can begin your journey straight away while the right person is found for you.
units.u018: Later, you can always open Find a Peer Guide and look for a match.
units.u019: A Peer Guide does not replace Christ, the Scriptures, your pastor, or the work of the Holy Spirit.
units.u020: Paul said it simply: I planted, Apollos watered, but God made it grow.
units.u021: A Peer Guide is a companion on the way.
units.u022: And one day, the person who was guided becomes a guide.
units.u023: What you have received, you pass on, to someone who is one step behind you.
units.u024: That is how discipleship grows: from one life to another, and from one generation to the next.
units.u025: Everyone is learning from someone, and helping someone grow.
units.u027: And who will you walk with?

05.title: A Church That Makes Disciples
05.description: How P2P supports a church's discipleship: equipping leaders, caring for members and sending people out.

units.u001: Before He ascended, Jesus gave His Church a clear commission: go and make disciples of all nations, teaching them to obey everything He commanded.
units.u002: Discipleship has always happened in the life of the church.
units.u004: Through small groups gathered around open Bibles.
units.u006: And through friendships, where one believer helps another to grow.
units.u007: Christ gave pastors and teachers to equip His people for the work of ministry.
units.u008: But between Sundays, it can be hard to know who is growing, who is struggling, and what each person's next step should be.
units.u009: P2P Global was built to help a local church strengthen this work, not to replace it.
units.u010: A church can register on P2P completely free, invite its members with a code, and give them one shared place to learn and grow together.
units.u011: Inside the church space, leaders find church chat, files and resources, gatherings, small groups, and announcements.
units.u012: Members can follow the Kingdom School foundations and study together, each keeping their own progress.
units.u013: A church can study the same Kingdom School lesson, or the same Kingdom Story, together.
units.u014: Small groups can work through it at their own pace, while each member keeps their own progress and their own reflections.
units.u015: Along the way, members complete short comprehension checks, and write personal reflections in their discipleship journal, so that learning becomes understanding, and understanding becomes a changed life.
units.u016: A community overview shows how many people are actively learning.
units.u017: It also gently highlights members who have been inactive for a while, and new believers who don't yet have a guide, so that no one quietly slips away.
units.u018: And because discipleship doesn't end at the church door, families can create a Family Circle to pray and learn together at home, while Peer Guides help newer believers walk with someone one step ahead of them.
units.u019: P2P does not take the place of your pastor, the gathered church, or the work of the Holy Spirit.
units.u020: It's a tool to help a congregation practise what Scripture already describes: believers devoted to the apostles' teaching and to fellowship, entrusting what they have received to faithful people who will teach others as well.
units.u021: A church that makes disciples raises up people who make disciples, in their homes, their workplaces, and their communities.
units.u022: Bring your church to P2P Global, and grow together.

06.title: The Bible and Deep Study
06.description: Reading the Bible in your language, and studying it more deeply with tools that help you understand.

units.u001: Scripture is God's word to us.
units.u002: The psalmist called it a lamp to his feet, and a light to his path.
units.u003: It deserves more than a quick glance.
units.u004: When the Bereans heard the message, they received it with great eagerness, and examined the Scriptures every day.
units.u005: P2P is designed to help you do the same: to read, to listen, to understand, and to live what you find.
units.u006: Open the Bible tab, and choose any book and chapter.
units.u007: Read in many translations and languages, and switch between them whenever you like.
units.u008: When you'd rather listen, the audio player reads Scripture aloud, so the Word can go with you as you walk, work, or rest.
units.u009: A good way to begin is simple.
units.u011: Ask what it shows you about God, about people, and about how to live.
units.u012: Then pray it back to God, and look for one way to obey it today.
units.u013: Select a verse to highlight it, and keep it in your Bible library.
units.u014: Compare a verse across several translations side by side.
units.u015: And search the whole Bible for a word or a theme.
units.u016: When you want to go further, Bible Study opens a distinct space for careful study.
units.u017: In Deep Study, you'll find a Biblical Dictionary, reference articles, commentaries, and word-study tools that show what the original words mean.
units.u018: Deep Study doesn't replace reading the Bible.
units.u020: You read the text first, then study it carefully, so that understanding leads to faith and obedience.
units.u021: All Scripture is God-breathed, and useful for instruction and for training in righteousness.
units.u026: Open the Bible in P2P today.

07.title: Learning in P2P
07.description: How learning works in P2P — lessons, stories, plans, studying together, reflection and growth.

units.u001: Learning in P2P is not about collecting lessons.
units.u002: It's about growing in understanding, so that the truth shapes the way you live.
units.u003: Let's follow one learner, Grace, as her journey unfolds.
units.u005: The Core Foundations lay a strong base, one module at a time: starting with Peer-to-Peer Orientation, then the Gospel and salvation, and on through the essentials of the Christian faith.
units.u006: When she's ready to go further, electives offer plans and courses in many subjects.
units.u007: Each lesson opens the Scriptures, explains them clearly, and ends with questions that help her understand and apply what she has read.
units.u008: Alongside her lessons, Kingdom Stories opens up the people and events of the Bible, like Abraham, the man who believed God's promise, told chapter by chapter.
units.u009: Along the way, short comprehension checks help her put what she has learned into her own words.
units.u010: Writing it down helps the truth move from her head to her heart.
units.u011: When she wants to explore a subject, like love, P2P Plans can help her build a personal study plan, with Scripture, supporting readings, and a schedule that fits her life.
units.u013: With Study Together, Grace can invite a friend, her Family Circle, or her church to study a Kingdom Story or a Kingdom School lesson together.
units.u014: Each person keeps their own progress, and her reflections stay private unless she chooses to share them.
units.u015: Her Learning Centre gathers everything in one place: the checks she still has to do, the work she has submitted, and the feedback when it arrives.
units.u016: And in her Discipleship Journal, she writes her reflections.
units.u017: What has God been teaching her?
units.u018: What is she struggling to apply?
units.u020: Over time, her growth is recorded through real evidence: lessons understood, truth applied, and people helped.
units.u021: Step by step, from Seed, toward Forest Builder.
units.u022: And as she grows, she begins to help others: inviting a friend to study with her, and one day, walking alongside someone who is just beginning.
units.u023: Learning is the beginning, not the destination.
units.u024: Scripture calls us to be doers of the word, and not hearers only.
units.u025: In P2P, everything you learn is meant to be lived, and passed on.

08.title: Discipleship Begins at Home
08.description: Family discipleship and Family Circle: learning, praying and growing together at home.

units.u001: Long before a child sits in a classroom, or a church pew, they learn at home.
units.u005: God told His people to keep His words on their hearts, and to teach them diligently to their children: when they sit at home, and when they walk along the road.
units.u006: Discipleship at home is rarely dramatic.
units.u007: It looks like a parent reading Scripture at the table.
units.u008: A family praying together before bed.
units.u009: A grandparent telling how God was faithful.
units.u010: And a child's question that deserves a patient answer.
units.u011: Timothy's faith first lived in his grandmother Lois, and in his mother Eunice.
units.u012: Faith is often passed on through ordinary family life, one day at a time.
units.u013: It also looks like parents who listen: who make room for honest questions, and who are not afraid to say, I don't know.
units.u015: P2P's Family Circle gives your household a shared space for this.
units.u016: Create your circle, and invite your family.
units.u017: Start a gathering for worship, Scripture, and prayer.
units.u018: Keep a family chat with messages and voice notes.
units.u019: Share your family's prayer requests, study together, and look back on the gatherings you've shared.
units.u020: Parents can listen to their children.
units.u021: Children can see faith lived out in front of them.
units.u022: And the whole family can grow, together.
units.u023: Discipleship should not stop at the church door.
units.u025: As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.

09.title: Kingdom Stories
09.description: The people and events of the Bible, told chapter by chapter.

units.u001: Long ago, God took a man named Abraham outside, and told him to look up at the heavens, and count the stars, if he could.
units.u005: A people were carried away, and brought home again.
units.u006: And when the time had fully come, God sent His Son.
units.u008: The One every promise had been pointing to.
units.u009: His followers carried the message from Jerusalem to the ends of the earth.
units.u010: The early Church gathered, prayed, suffered, and grew.
units.u011: This is the story of God at work in history.
units.u012: And everything written in the past was written for our instruction, so that we might have hope.
units.u014: A growing collection of the people and events of the Bible, and of the Church through the ages.
units.u015: Explore them chapter by chapter, in P2P Global.

10.title: Kingdom School
10.description: Structured biblical learning that builds a strong foundation, one lesson at a time.

units.u001: Jesus said that everyone who hears His words, and acts on them, is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
units.u002: Strong lives are built on strong foundations.
units.u003: Kingdom School is P2P Global's structured path through the essentials of the Christian faith.
units.u004: Core Foundations begins with Peer-to-Peer Orientation, and the Gospel and salvation, and continues step by step through more than one hundred and eighty lessons, and growing.
units.u005: Electives offer plans and courses to go further.
units.u006: Each lesson opens the Scriptures, explains them, and checks your understanding, so that knowledge becomes conviction, and conviction becomes a changed life.

overlays.l01: “…everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.”
overlays.l02: Learn systematically.  Understand deeply.  Live faithfully.

11.title: From Learning to Living
11.description: How what we learn shapes everyday life, relationships, decisions and service.

units.u002: A verse, read early in the morning, before the day gets loud.
units.u004: She opens a study, and looks closer at what it means.
units.u005: And she asks: what does this show me about God?
units.u006: And what does it ask of me?
units.u010: A small decision about how to live today.
units.u012: At home, she listens a little longer.
units.u013: At work, she tells the truth, even when it would be easier not to.
units.u014: In her community, she notices someone who needs help, and she stops.
units.u015: On Sunday, she worships with her church, and listens to the Word preached.
units.u016: At her son's school, she reads with a child who is struggling.
units.u017: With an old friend, she chooses to forgive.
units.u019: But each one is the Word, lived.
units.u020: Scripture calls us to be doers of the word, and not hearers only.
units.u021: A friend asks her what has changed.
units.u022: So she shares what she has been learning.
units.u023: Weeks later, that friend opens the same Scriptures, and begins to grow.
units.u024: So they begin to read together, once a week.
units.u028: And one day, that friend will do the same for someone else.
units.u029: This is the heart of P2P Global.
units.u031: The truth we receive is meant to shape the way we live, and the way we help others grow.
